content: <thought>Based on the mass spectrum, the molecular ion is at m/z 114.06808, which matches the exact monoisotopic mass of the formula C₆H₁₀O₂ (C6 = 72.0000, H10 = 10.0783, O2 = 31.9898 → total = 114.0681). The DBE is 2, consistent with a lactone (one ring and one carbonyl). The most common C₆H₁₀O₂ lactone is ε‑caprolactone, whose SMILES is “O=C1CCCCCO1”. I will validate this SMILES.
